lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: This is the KD Brief. Today's tech report: your AI agent can learn new skills.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: So, what's a skill? Just a folder: a SKILL dot MD file with instructions, plus optional scripts and references, loaded only when needed.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Installing one is a single line, npx skills add, and it works with almost eighty agents.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Our picks: Anatomy for isometric explainers, Supabase for your database, and two KD video skills, including this one.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The trick? Don't ask for a nice video. Storyboard first, then let the agent build.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Every skill is on the KD wiki. Learn, build, ship.
